title: Guided Two Hour Horseback Trail Ride in Central Florida
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness

**Max Weight:** This sliding scale is directly related to the physical requirements needed to maintain safe and appropriate balance while sitting in a saddle. While participants are riding, their center of gravity (and balance) is altered by being elevated in a seated position. We adhere to this requirement because: 1. Participants who fall outside this range are significantly more likely to fall off their horse and injure themselves. 2. Participants who fall outside this range and do not have advanced training and experience* in riding techniques, correct riding posture, and correct seated balance in the saddle, cause excess strain on a horse’s back. **Feet Inches --> Max Pounds:** 4' 0" --> 100 4' 1" --> 105 4' 2" --> 110 4' 3" --> 115 4' 4" --> 120 4' 5" --> 125 4' 6" --> 130 4' 7" --> 135 4' 8" --> 140 4' 9" --> 145 4' 10" --> 150 4' 11" --> 155 5' 0" --> 160 5' 1" --> 165 5' 2" --> 170 5' 3" --> 175 5' 4" --> 180 5' 5" --> 185 5' 6" --> 190 5' 7" --> 195 5' 8" --> 200 5' 9" --> 205 5' 10" --> 210 5' 11" --> 215 6' 0" --> 220 6' 1" --> 225 6' 2" --> 230 6' 3" --> 235 6' 4" --> 240 6' 5" --> 245 6' 6" --> 250 6' 7" --> 255 For participants who are over 6'7", please contact us to discuss riding options. *We do not make exceptions for participants who personally attest to having advanced training and experience. Due to the nature of our business, it is impossible to properly verify training and experience through personal attestation. We apologize for any inconvenience.
All participants must have a BMI score of 31 or lower. Information on and how to calculate your BMI can be found here: https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/calculate-your-bmi
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the enchanting landscapes of Rock Springs Run State Reserve on a guided two-hour horseback trail ride. Led by two experienced and friendly wranglers, this adventure takes you through diverse eco-communities, where you’ll encounter a variety of wildlife and lush flora. As you traverse six miles of scenic trails, the guides will share fascinating insights into the natural and cultural history of the park, enriching your journey. Perfect for riders of all skill levels, this trail ride promises a unique and immersive experience in nature's beauty.
